I need to find every RPC method in ShortcutService and identify the backend file that implements each one.

I'll read the ShortcutService proto file to list the RPC methods, then locate their backend implementations.

ShortcutService has five RPCs. I am identifying the backend files that implement each one.

The RPCs are ListShortcuts, GetShortcut, CreateShortcut, UpdateShortcut, and DeleteShortcut. They are implemented in server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go. ConnectServiceHandler in connect_services.go delegates to APIV1Service.

All five RPCs are implemented in shortcut_service.go.

Connect wrappers delegate from connect_services.go.

- `GetShortcut` — line 95
